text: Three teams, three queries, three different active-member counts -- that ends now. We're rebuilding Power BI directly on member_activity_mart and revenue_mart, the governed marts this series has been building toward.

Three decisions keep it from drifting again: Import mode, since these marts refresh nightly; single-direction relationships through dim_locations; and measures that quote the mart's columns instead of re-deriving the active-member rule in DAX.
Active Members, Net Revenue, Revenue per Active Member -- each one a plain aggregation of a column the mart already computed, checked by hand against Snowflake before any visual existed.
Finance's old query used a billing-presence rule. Marketing's was a month-end snapshot that missed mid-month pauses. Product's only counted app check-ins. All three get a real retirement date.
The model's validated. Next: the meeting where Finance, Marketing, and Product see this number together for the first time -- and it doesn't match any of their old ones.
